canonical_action: No skills.json mutation. No new PQ relationship edges were created; this batch only adds provenance mappings for already-canonical skills and already-documented PQ rewards.
next: Audit the next DLC event whose registered skill count exceeds its individually mapped skill count. Preserve unresolved mappings rather than assigning IDs from DLC proximity alone.
